presets.name: Moody Narrow Stereo
presets.description: Tight, claustrophobic stereo field for introspective beats
presets.tips: Creates intimate, narrow stereo image. Perfect for vocals and atmospheric pads.

presets.name: Club Wide Stereo
presets.description: Maximum width while maintaining mono compatibility
presets.tips: Wide stereo with Haas effect. Check mono! Bass should bypass this.
presets.warning: Not mono-safe - use only on mid/high frequency elements

presets.name: Lo-Fi Mono Collapse
presets.description: Vintage narrow stereo like old cassettes
presets.tips: Reduces stereo width for vintage vibe. Combine with saturation.

presets.name: 808 Bass Mono Lock
presets.description: Forces bass to mono while preserving stereo harmonics
presets.tips: Complete mono collapse. Use with multiband to only affect low frequencies.
presets.workflow: Use in Patcher with crossover - only process below 150Hz

presets.name: Trap Hi-Hat Spread
presets.description: Maximum width for hi-hat rolls and trap patterns
presets.tips: Extreme width for trap hi-hats. Will have phase issues in mono.

presets.name: Vocal Center Extract
presets.tips: Converts LR to MS. Solo Mid to hear vocals. Use MS-to-LR preset to convert back.

presets.name: Karaoke Effect
presets.tips: Cancels center content. Only works on perfectly centered elements.

presets.name: Melodic Pad Width
presets.description: Moderate width for lush pads and synths
presets.tips: Subtle width enhancement. Safe for melodic elements.

presets.name: Funky Guitar Spread
presets.description: Wide stereo for guitar loops and funk samples
presets.tips: Adds spaciousness to funk loops. Check mono on bass-heavy samples.

presets.name: Sample Vintage Width
presets.tips: Authentic 90s stereo width. Perfect for boom bap production.

presets.name: Build-Up Width Automation
presets.tips: Start here, automate to 'Club Wide Stereo' for drops.
presets.workflow: Automate matrix sliders during build-up sections

presets.name: Side-Only Processing Setup
presets.description: Extracts only Side component for processing
presets.tips: Solo 'Side' after applying this. Process sides separately from mid.
presets.workflow: Use in Patcher with parallel Mid/Side chains

workflows.name: MS Processing Chain
steps: 1. Load 'Vocal Center Extract' preset (LR to MS)
3. Process each channel with separate effects
4. Load another Stereo Shaper after effects
5. Use 'MS to LR' preset to convert back

workflows.name: Width Automation
steps: 2. Create automation clip for matrix sliders
4. Always check mono compatibility after automation

tips: Always check mono compatibility with mixer mono button
Bass frequencies (below 150Hz) should always be mono
Use correlation meter in Fruity Limiter to check phase
Automate width for dynamic mixes (narrow verse, wide chorus)
Negative matrix values create width but risk mono cancellation
Delay knob adds Haas effect - use 5-30ms for stereo width
Phase inversion creates extreme width but destroys mono
Use Patcher for complex MS processing chains
Save your matrix settings as presets for recall
Trust your ears - if it sounds wrong in mono, fix it
